title: Black Hole & Light Bending
guideExplore: Scrub from stellar collapse to light bending at the event horizon.
guideCollapse: Watch the core shrink during collapse toward the event horizon.
guideBending: See photon paths curve — some escape, some fall in.
conditionsHint: First half: collapse. Second half: gravitational lensing near the horizon.
quizCorrect: The boundary where light cannot escape
quizWrong: A solid surface of the black hole
learnMore: Nothing — not even light — can escape from inside the event horizon.
